name: Kuya Rick
about:
Somewhere between chasing waves and exploring the islands, Ricky found another way to experience the ocean — through photography.

From perfect barrels and turquoise waters to golden sunsets and the untouched beauty of the Mentawais, his photographs are a reflection of the places, people, and moments that inspire him.

No two waves are ever the same
